items.name: Evercraft Web
items.text: Evercraft Web: Evercraft Web is an Evercraft ai web fetch search browser infrastructure capability. Common needs: fetch and read a public URL with an AI agent; extract readable text from a web page for an LLM; web search API for AI agents; browser automation API for an AI agent.

items.name: Legacy Rescue Lab
items.text: Legacy Rescue Lab: Legacy Rescue Lab is an Evercraft legacy software rescue and modernization capability. Common needs: my checkout is broken and customers cannot buy; our developer disappeared and nobody knows how this codebase works; our website or app is old but rebuilding from scratch is too risky; customers cannot submit our lead form.

items.name: Systemia Portfolio Sentinel
items.text: Systemia Portfolio Sentinel: Systemia Portfolio Sentinel is an Evercraft continuous software portfolio integrity monitoring capability. Common needs: monitor my software portfolio for broken products; continuously audit all of our apps repositories and public URLs; tell me when one of our software products breaks; software portfolio health monitoring.

items.name: Systemia Remote Ops
items.text: Systemia Remote Ops: Systemia Remote Ops is an Evercraft public capability. Common needs: I am thinking about starting a business and want to test the idea before I commit; simulate a business before I start it; business simulator for a new company; business digital twin for decision making.
